user_data_email_body:
Download a copy of your data recorded by Focus Bear at

{link}

Please note that this link expires after 7 days.


Privacy & Support

Your privacy is important to us. This email and any files transmitted with it are confidential and intended solely for the use of the individual or entity to whom they are addressed.

For support or any questions, please email us at: support@focusbear.io

For more information, visit https://www.focusbear.io/en/privacy-policy
